notes:
Summary: Large EU-headquartered fintech holding company evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for analyst-facing LLM features. Primary ask: strict EU-only data residency with ability to offer UK and Canada regional partitions, audit log export to Splunk, and customer-managed keys (Azure Key Vault / AWS KMS).

Call highlights: 
- 2026-02-14: Intro with CTO (Fireflies ff_20260214_01). CTO: 'can't allow model requests or cache to leave EU jurisdiction.' Emphasis on contractual data residency guarantees and proof of architectural controls.
- Security wants HSM-backed KMS option and ability to rotate keys monthly.
- Networking: private endpoints + no NAT egress for inference nodes; will require VPC peering and transit gateway controls.
- Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 mandatory; legal raised data processing addendum (DPA) changes for UK & Canada.
- Cost: sensitive — procurement prefers committed reserved capacity for predictable unit economics; open to Dedicated vs Private after POC.

POC scope (proposed): 
- Deploy Redwood Private into a customer VPC in eu-west-1 with EU-only routing.
- Validate KMS integration: customer-managed key to encrypt model cache and logs.
- End-to-end audit logging: deliver Splunk ingest sample and retention proof.
- Latency test under 50/150ms p50/p95 for short-chattish workloads and embedding bulk throughput.

Quotes/paraphrase: 'We need contractual residency guarantees, not just regional hints.' — Head of Legal.

Internal notes for deal team: prioritize SE time to complete KMS spike (Marcus), prepare security FAQ with HSM/KMS diagrams, coordinate Legal + Sales for DPA redlines. Procurement expects initial SOW and pricing by 2026-03-20.

Docs requested: security architecture diagram, runbook for key rotation, sample audit log schema, example DPA amendment.
use_case_summary: Fintech use: embeddings for customer transaction similarity, reranking for fraud alert triage, analyst chat assistant for case summarization. Requires deterministic residency and auditability.
latency_targets: p50 < 50ms (chat), p95 < 200ms; strict requirement p50 < 150ms for analyst workflows
throughput_targets: steady-state 200 req/s embeddings batch windows; burst to 800 req/s for reranking during batch jobs
